# Playback fixtures

These are runtime test fixtures, not exercise demonstrations. They are not
declared in Flutter production assets.

- playback.riv: off_road_car.riv from rive_native 0.1.11, MIT (RIVE_LICENSE).
- playback.webp: hello_loop_2.webp from Flutter's engine UI fixtures,
  Flutter BSD license (FLUTTER_LICENSE).
- playback.json: locally authored shape-only Lottie test, no external media.
